usedFor: Contacts+ holds your contacts and tags, and Slack receives a message through “Send Message” when a tag changes.

bestTemplate.name: “Tag Updated” in Contacts+, then “Send Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: The message carries the tag change to the channel, so nobody checks the contact list to find out.

watchOut: An automation's post to a Slack channel waits for approval, so “Send Message” will not post unattended.
